items.title: How often you check determines how fast you catch a lying status code
items.description: Team B's monitor validated the body shape, not just the status code — but it still only checks on a schedule. Drag the poll interval to see how that alone bounds detection time. At the default 40s interval, this reproduces Team B's own ~40 second detection time from the scenario above.

items.title: How payload size and bandwidth determine transfer time
items.description: The response body from the request/response cycle above still has to travel over the network. Drag the sliders to see how a bigger payload or a slower connection changes how long that takes.
